visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A male creator with styled brown hair and a white T-shirt is in a brightly lit indoor room. He holds a matte black rectangular makeup compact very close to the camera, obscuring his face initially. The background shows a minimalist room with a bed and a grey wall. Yellow subtitles appear at the bottom. (2) The creator holds the compact open, revealing a mirror and a light apricot-colored blush powder inside. He smiles warmly with his eyes squinting slightly. A small black brush is tucked inside the compact. (3) The camera cuts to a close-up of the creator's forearm where he swatches the peach-toned powder. His skin texture is clear, and the lighting highlights the subtle pigment. (4) He uses the small brush to apply the powder to his right cheekbone, looking into the compact's mirror. His movements are precise and gentle. (5) A second compact is shown, featuring a pale lilac-pink color. He swatches this on his wrist next to the first color, then applies it over his cheek. On-screen graphics show the product name and price. (6) A third compact with a deeper rosy-tan shade is introduced. He swatches it and applies it, emphasizing the finish. (7) The final frame shows a split-screen or montage of the three blush shades side-by-side for comparison.
